checks.label: cursor worker access
checks.detail: in Cursor's sandbox (cursor-agent sandbox run), a worker cannot: lock-dir write (Error: command failed unexpectedly.); loopback bind (Error: command failed unexpectedly.); outbound HTTPS (Error: command failed unexpectedly.); docker version (Error: command failed unexpectedly.)
checks.fix:
lock-dir write: a native Cursor worker writes only where ~/.cursor/sandbox.json or the repo's .cursor/sandbox.json lets it: add the directory to additionalReadwritePaths there, or isolate cursor (harness.cursor.isolated), whose sandbox.json catherd writes
loopback bind: Cursor's sandbox blocks this bind: allow it in ~/.cursor/sandbox.json's networkPolicy, or isolate cursor
outbound HTTPS: Cursor's sandbox reaches only the domains networkPolicy allows: add the registry to networkPolicy.allow in ~/.cursor/sandbox.json, or isolate cursor
docker version: Cursor's sandbox cannot reach the Docker socket: run the Docker checks in the verifier (full access), or give the role full access
